candidates.change_summary: Remove the require check that msg.sender equals owner, allowing anyone to call sendTo.
Remove the require check that receiver is not address(0), allowing transfers to the zero address which will revert or self-destruct depending on recipient.
Remove the require check that amount is greater than 0, allowing zero-amount transfers that succeed but change no balances.
Change the owner check from msg.sender == owner to msg.sender != owner, inverting the access control condition.
Change the transfer call from payable(receiver).transfer(amount) to payable(msg.sender).transfer(amount), sending funds to the caller instead of the receiver.
Change the transfer call to send funds to the contract owner instead of the specified receiver.
